## Creative direction

Treat endpoint engineering as dependable transformation. Begin with a text-led, high-confidence opening; substantiate it immediately with a four-item evidence band; then reveal projects, public toolkits, chronology, grouped capabilities, credentials, and an intentional contact close. Use disciplined editorial alignment, restrained technical geometry, and distinct section compositions rather than a repeated card grid.

## Responsive behavior

Preserve the approved section order across mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop, and wide desktop. Recompose relationships instead of shrinking them: stack metrics, keep project impact visible when details collapse, retain readable technology labels, protect text measure, and provide generous touch targets. No content or action may depend on hover.

## Motion and reduced motion

Use brief, low-amplitude structural reveals only where they clarify hierarchy. Do not animate metric values, loop decorative movement, or delay reading. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, render every section, value, diagram label, interaction state, and action immediately in its complete static form.

## Accessibility and performance

Use semantic landmarks and heading order, visible keyboard focus, descriptive links, strong contrast, accessible disclosure state, and a text equivalent for the conceptual process visual. Prefer CSS and lightweight local geometry. Do not fetch runtime media, fonts, or components from the network.

## Resource authority

Every listed resource and component is optional. Empty candidate lists intentionally exercise semantic local fallbacks; they never authorize fabricated screenshots, portraits, dashboards, evidence, metrics, routes, or destinations.
